Tesseract OCR, for reading day sheets in the browser (assets/day-sheets.js).
Loaded only when a day sheet that has no text of its own is dropped in.

  tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js        tesseract.js 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0)
  tesseract-core-*-lstm.wasm.js          tesseract.js-core 6.1.2 (Apache-2.0)
  lang/eng.traineddata                   tessdata_fast English (Apache-2.0)
